cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: Hello Charlotte. I'm Kaeden, one of the supervisors. Welcome to the team.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: Don't worry. People often get my name wrong; they never know how to spell it.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: It's K-A-E-D-E-N, in case you ever need to write it.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: So, there are a few practical things you need to sort out this morning.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: Then I'll show you what you're going to do today.

cues.speaker: TE
cues.text: The email I received said to go to the front desk, to show my letter of appointment and

cues.speaker: TE
cues.text: pick up my badge.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: You'll need that for the staffroom and other areas of the supermarket where shoppers

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: aren't allowed.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: So, after you've finished at the front desk, I'll take you to the staffroom.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: Put your coat and rucksack in one of the lockers there. Take whichever one is free.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: Yes. Try not to lose it.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: At the end of the day, leave it in the door for the next person to use.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: You also need to go to the HR department to see Tiffany. She's really helpful.

cues.speaker: TE
cues.text: I was told to bring my passport with me. HR need to take a note of the number in it.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: OK. Tiffany will give you a uniform.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: They have lots in different sizes, so you just tell her what you need.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: I won't come with you to HR – I've got to go and sort something else out.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: Problem with a bread slicer.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: The staffroom's on the first floor, and HR are a couple of floors above that, on the

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: third floor. There's a staircase outside the staffroom.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: When you've finished with HR, come and find me in the bakery section of the shop.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: I'll just give you my phone number, in case you can't find me.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: Have you got your phone there?

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: It's oh-four-one-two double-six-five nine-oh-three.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: So, Charlotte, your tasks today are in the bakery section, on the sushi counter, and on

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: the meat and fish counters.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: The first job is to check sell-by dates on the bread and cakes.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: If any of the dates are today's, put a new price label on the packaging.

cues.speaker: TE
cues.text: What if any of the labels are yesterday's dates, or older? Do I throw those items away?

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: Yes, but that shouldn't happen – we check the stock every day.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: When something needs a new price label, put a yellow one on the package, next to the

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: original price.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: After that, you'll go to the sushi takeaway counter.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: You'll see lots of flat cardboard boxes at one end of the counter.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: Beneath those is where we keep the plastic boxes -we run out of those really quickly, so

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: you should bring more from the storeroom.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: No. You also need to clean the area where they prepare the dishes.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: There are cloths and bottles of spray by the sink.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: Oh, and please make sure you clean that too.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: Absolutely. But you mustn't wash up knives.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: You have to do some training before you're allowed to touch sharp objects.

cues.speaker: TE
cues.text: OK, thanks. I don't want to get anything wrong.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: Don't worry. You'll be fine. And I'll be around to help.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: Finally, the meat and fish counters.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: You need to clean the area where staff serve customers, including wiping the weighing

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: scales.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: The fish is laid on ice, but when that starts to melt, you'll need to get more from the

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: cold-room.

cues.speaker: TE
cues.text: I know the staff on the food counters wear a hat. Will that be the same for me?

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: You won't be serving customers directly, so no.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: But make sure you put on thermal gloves when you take anything out of the cold-room.

cues.speaker: EN
cues.text: The temperature's low enough in there to get frostbite from touching things.
